reason: Conversation 1 walks the user through the right safe checks (unplug, clear the hair and tassel, inspect the belt), correctly diagnoses a snapped drive belt caused by the jam, and points them to the belt for U85-AS-Be, with a part card showing a belt confirmed to fit.
